Name: Turn Ginger Island into a naturist resort
Author: Fluffmaestro93
Description:
Character Sprites and portraits for all the ladies except for Pam (only character sprite for her!). Only visual changes, no changes to dialogue. This only applies to the "character_beach" xnb-files. So when at home the residents stay clothed. 

The characters are redrawn, I reused som assets from the "Younger Marnie-Mod" with permission. https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1198

I personally use the "Hot Pam nude portrait"-mod for this
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/326). 

For the lads of Stardew Valley I use the corresponding sprites and portraits from "Horny Bachelors-mod". Only the "character_beach" versions. 
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2564?tab=files

I don't know how to make it content patcher-compatible. Therefore I replace the portrait and character xnb-files in the corresponding folder AFTER having them backed up. 

Instructions:
Backup the folders 
Install directory\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters
Install directory\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits

Then copy and paste the XNB files from the mod's corresponding "Characters" and "Portraits" folders into the above mentioned folders. 

Feel free to redraw and reuse the files as you see fit. It's a nude mod after all. Not my life's most important work.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
